fair_value.method: Blend of a pro-forma SOTP (bear-ish and constructive variants, midpoint ~$9.4) and a discounted 2028 run-rate EV/EBITDA (~$8.3), lifted modestly for strategic/government-support optionality; all on ~328M pro-forma shares (≈262M post-ASM + 65.9M VAC consideration shares) and ~$0.84B pro-forma net debt + Ara preferred after paying $718M cash for VAC.

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: Midpoint of two cases. Low case EV $3.3B: US uranium (White Mesa, Pinyon Plain ~2M lb/yr at ~$23/lb cost, resources) $1.0B; White Mesa REE incl. heavy-REE circuits (Tb/Dy end-2027) $0.6B; VAC (2025 adj. EBITDA $29M, Sumter 2,000 tpa run-rate $65-75M) $1.0B EV; ASM (Korean Metals Plant 1,300 tpa + Dubbo) $0.25B; Donald/Toliara/Bahia $0.4B; vanadium/isotopes $0.05B -> equity ~$2.45B = $7.5/sh. Constructive case EV $4.5B (uranium $1.3B at ~$150M EBITDA x ~8.5x; REE $1.0B; VAC $1.3B; ASM $0.3B; Donald/Toliara $0.6B) -> equity ~$3.66B = $11.2/sh. Net claims: $700M 0.75% converts (conv. $20.34, out of the money, treated as debt) + VAC net debt $140M + Ara preferred up to $135M, less ~$150M liquidity left after $718M VAC cash (from $936M cash+securities at 6/30/26); ~328M shares.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2028 run-rate pro-forma EBITDA ~$200M (uranium ~$120M at ~$85-95/lb realized; VAC ~$100M as Sumter ramps toward 4,000 tpa ($130-140M run-rate per company); REE oxides ~$30M; ASM ~$10M; less ~$60M corporate G&A) x 20x strategic multiple = $4.0B, discounted one year at 12% = $3.57B EV, less ~$0.84B net debt/pref = $2.73B / 328M shares.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Strategic-premium cross-check: market's willingness to pay for a Western mine-to-magnet platform with OSC $725M conditional 20-year loan and DoD/government backing; haircut sell-side mean (~$24) by ~40% for promotional bias and the fact targets were set largely pre-dilution; low-end targets BMO $18, Roth $16.

bear.story: US-China rare-earth thaw keeps the Western REE/magnet premium compressing; VAC closes (early 2027) with Ara preferred triggered and integration/Sumter ramp slower than the $65-75M EBITDA run-rate; heavy-REE capex and Donald funding push toward another equity raise or more converts near lows; uranium spot slips from ~$90 toward $70. Stock re-rates to ~1.5x a weak SOTP.

base.story: Uranium holds $85-95 spot with ~2M lb/yr output at low cost and another mill run in late 2026/early 2027; VAC closes and Sumter ramps; Tb/Dy circuits on track for end-2027; Donald FID achieved. Market keeps a strategic premium over my ~$9.75 fair value but the ~30% VAC dilution and cash burn cap the rerating; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: Renewed China export-control escalation or US policy support (price floors, offtakes, OSC loan finalized) re-ignites the critical-minerals trade; VAC Sumter expansion to 4,000 tpa with OEM contracts; uranium term price near $100. Stock recovers toward the lower end of analyst targets ($18-25), like its $27.90 peak within the past year.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$6.50 the equity would be worth less than my low-case SOTP (~$7.5) minus a margin, i.e. the market would be saying the VAC purchase ($718M cash + stock) destroyed value, financing (converts at $20.34, OSC loan, heavy-REE capex, Donald sole-funding) forces heavily dilutive raises, or the uranium franchise (Pinyon Plain) disappointed. That is ~43% below spot, within reach of 89% vol but more likely to reflect a fundamental break (failed VAC close/integration, lost OSC loan, uranium below ~$65) than noise.

catalysts.event: Donald Project FID (Astron / Energy Fuels JV) and Export Finance Australia debt package
Q3-2026 results: uranium sales vs 1.5-2.0M lb guidance, cash burn, ASM consolidation
Next uranium mill run at White Mesa
VAC acquisition closing; regulatory approvals; Ara preferred ($135M max) triggered if EF share price < $20.93
FY2026 results and 2027 guidance (uranium, REE, magnets)
Korean Metals Plant expansion to 3,600 tpa; OSC $725M loan finalization
US-China rare-earth trade headlines (export controls vs thaw)
Uranium spot/term price (~$90 spot, ~$97 term in mid-2026)

key_uncertainties: Whether the market keeps paying a strategic premium for Western REE/magnet supply as US-China relations shift
VAC integration and Sumter ramp versus a ~65x trailing-EBITDA purchase price
Funding of heavy-REE expansion, Donald earn-in and Toliara, and risk of further dilution
Uranium price path and durability of Pinyon Plain high-grade low-cost production
Exact pro-forma share count and net debt after ASM, VAC and Ara preferred
reasoning: UUUU (Energy Fuels) closed $11.35, near its 52-week low after a ~60% drop from $27.90, even though uranium is strong (~$90/lb spot, up ~20% y/y) and the uranium business runs well (Q2-26: 865k lb produced at ~$23/lb, 2026 guidance kept). The derating comes from the June-2026 $1.9B VAC deal ($718M cash + 65.9M shares, ~30% dilution, ~65x trailing EBITDA, with a preferred-share top-up to the seller if the stock is below $20.93 at close) and a broad rare-earth selloff on US-China thaw headlines (Sept 2026). After VAC the company swaps most of its ~$936M liquidity for a magnet business, keeps $700M converts (conversion price $20.34, far out of the money) and faces heavy capex (heavy-REE circuits, Donald), with the OSC $725M loan still conditional. My SOTP on ~328M pro-forma shares gives $7.5-11.2 and a discounted 2028 EV/EBITDA gives ~$8.3; with a small strategic-premium cross-check the blend is ~$9.75, a bit below spot. Sell-side is uniformly Buy (targets $16-33, mean ~$24) but these are anchored on pre-dilution prices and I discount them. For the distribution I centred the 12-month median slightly below spot (~$11.0): below-spot fair value and dilution/funding risk, partly offset by strong uranium, sector mean reversion after a 60% drawdown, and very bullish analyst positioning. I used a lognormal width of ~0.72 (below the 89% realized vol, because the event-driven swings are partly behind it but the stock remains a high-beta theme name), giving ~48% above spot, ~20% above $19.86, ~10% above $28 and ~25% below $6.81. Research was limited to about 13 web searches plus page fetches; Twelve Data stats and targets were unavailable on the current plan. No option data was used.
